SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
File No. 8985(C.)
S. 1, Special Branch
REPORT
Date October 23, 39.
Subject... MCALLAN. MARY ANN.
Made by... D.S. Anderson Forwarded by... C. Crawford
With reference to the attached letter dated
October 16, 1939 requesting information regarding the
above person, the following particulars are available.
Mary Ann McAllan, nee Noble, born in Shanghai
August 12th, 1904, is of mixed parentage. Her father,
J. Noble, British subject, proprietor of the Blue Cross
Dog Hospital, 170 Edinburgh Road at one time held the rank
of sergeant in the Hong Kong Police and her mother is
an Australian born Chinese.
Mrs. McAllan was divorced from her husband in
Shanghai on December 16th, 1933 the latter obtaining
custody of the two children resulting from the marriage.
The reason for divorce proceedings was that Mrs. McAllan
had become infatuated with a Private Samuel Moffat of
the Argyle & Sutherland Highlanders, which regiment
was stationed in Shanghai at the time. At the hearing
of the case at British Supreme Court, the fact that she
act
had been seen in the/of committing adultery with Moffat
in Jessfield Park, decided the case.
It is known that an illegitimate child of which
Moffat is the father was born to Mrs. McAllan in the
early part of 1934.
Since that time she has been leading a very
secluded life and as a result, any further information
has been difficult to obtain.
A S Anderson.
D. S.
D. C.(Special Branch).

关于所附1939年10月16日来信，要求提供上述人员的信息，现有以下详情。
玛丽·安·麦卡伦，婚前姓诺布尔 (Noble)，1904年8月12日出生于上海，为混血儿。其父 J. 诺布尔 (J. Noble)，英国臣民，“蓝十字狗医院” (Blue Cross Dog Hospital) 业主，地址爱丁堡路 (Edinburgh Road) 170号，曾任香港警察警长；其母为出生于澳大利亚的华人。
麦卡伦夫人于1933年12月16日在上海与丈夫离婚，后者获得婚姻所生两名子女的监护权。提起离婚诉讼的原因是麦卡伦夫人迷恋上阿盖尔和萨瑟兰高地团 (Argyle & Sutherland Highlanders) 的一名二等兵塞缪尔·莫法特 (Samuel Moffat)，该团当时驻扎在上海。在英国最高法院审理该案时，她在极司菲尔公园 (Jessfield Park) 被看见与莫法特通奸的事实，决定了案件结果。
据悉，麦卡伦夫人在1934年初生下一名非婚生子女，父亲为莫法特。
自那时起，她一直过着非常隐居的生活，因此，很难获取进一步的信息。
A S 安德森。
侦探警佐 (D. S.)

From:-
O.C "A" Coy.
1st. Bn., THE SEAFORTH HLDRS

To:- Deputy Commissioner in Charge of Special Branch
S.M. Police
Date 16/10/49

Dear Sir. Subject:- Confidential enquiry

I shall be most grateful if you can forward me
a short report on Miss Mae Allan residing at
name 1293 House 2. Yu Yuen Road.
A soldier of my company is desirous
of marrying this lady and it is necessary
to obtain some information as to character
before such permission can be granted and
I thought you would not mind if I asked
you to make the enquiry for me.

Yours truly
J.C. Powell
CAPTAIN

Date December 6, 19 38.
Subject Mrs. Mary Ann McALLAN, British Eurasian.
CONFIDENTIAL
Made by D. S. Pitts. Forwarded by C Gaskin
Mary Ann McAllan, née NOBLE, was born in Shanghai on
August 12, 1904 of a British father and an Australian Chinese
mother. Her father, J. NOBLE, retired from the Hong Kong
Police many years ago when holding the rank of sergeant.
After coming to Shanghai he operated a profitable dairy on
Lay Road, which he later sold out. At present he is the
sole proprietor of the Blue Cross Dog Hospital, well-known
local veterinary institution, located at No. 170 Edinburgh
Road.
The daughter was married to William Primrose McAllan,
a British subject born at Dumbarton on April 5, 1899, at
the B. M. Consulate-General on April 7, 1923 and bore her
husband two daughters, Mary Primrose being born on November
4, 1923, and Charlotte Beatrice Elsie first seeing the light
of day on December 14, 1926.
The marriage proceeded on more or less normal lines
until 1933 when the couple became estranged and she left
her husband in July of the same year. Investigation
reveals that, a constant visitor to dances held at the
British Forces Recreation Centre on Ferry Road, she became
infatuated with a Private Samuel MOFFAT, who was stationed
in Shanghai at the time as a member of the Argyle & Sutherland
Highlanders. As a result of this infatuation she cohabited
with the soldier and in September, 1933, was caught in the
act of committing adultery with him in Jessfield Park.
As a natural sequel, Mr. McAllan petitioned for
divorce before the British Supreme Court in the latter part
of 1933, named Moffat as the co-respondent and citing the
above mentioned instance of adultery, proved his case and

玛丽·安·麦卡伦，婚前姓诺布尔 (NOBLE)，1904年8月12日出生于上海，父亲为英国人，母亲为澳籍华人。其父 J. 诺布尔 (J. NOBLE) 多年前从香港警察退休，退休时职衔为警长。来到上海后，他在雷路 (Lay Road) 经营一家利润丰厚的奶牛场，后来将其出售。目前，他是位于爱丁堡路 (Edinburgh Road) 170号的“蓝十字狗医院” (Blue Cross Dog Hospital) 的唯一业主，这是一家当地知名的兽医机构。
女儿于1923年4月7日在英国驻沪总领事馆嫁给威廉·普里姆罗斯·麦卡伦 (William Primrose McAllan)，后者为英国臣民，1899年4月5日出生于邓巴顿 (Dumbarton)，并为丈夫生下两个女儿，玛丽·普里姆罗斯 (Mary Primrose) 出生于1923年11月4日，夏洛特·比阿特丽斯·埃尔西 (Charlotte Beatrice Elsie) 出生于1926年12月14日。
这段婚姻大体正常地维持到1933年，当时夫妇关系疏远，她于同年7月离开丈夫。调查显示，作为渡船路 (Ferry Road) 英军娱乐中心举办舞会的常客，她迷恋上当时作为阿盖尔和萨瑟兰高地团成员驻扎在上海的二等兵塞缪尔·莫法特 (Samuel MOFFAT)。由于这种迷恋，她与这名士兵同居，并于1933年9月在极司菲尔公园 (Jessfield Park) 与他通奸时被当场抓获。
作为自然结果，麦卡伦先生于1933年下半年向英国最高法院提起离婚诉讼，指名莫法特为共同被告，并引用上述通奸事例，证实了他的案情，并且

page_data.en:
From:-
O. C. “A” Coy.
1ST BN., THE SEAFORTH HIGHLANDERS.

To:-

Date

Dear Major,

Ref our talk on the telephone.

The name of the lady in question is
Mary Anne McMillan, a British subject residing
at Lane 1293 Yu Chen Road. She is
the wife of a member of the Police Force and was
divorced some years ago. More than that I
cannot say. I do not know.

I wonder if you could be kind enough
to let me have any information about
her, as one of the men in my company
wishes to marry her, and the Commanding
Officer wishes to know more about her before he
gives his consent. The man is a good chap and
I should like to help him if I can.

Yours sincerely,

[Signature]

无可奉告。我不知道。

不知您能否好心地

如果可能的话，我想帮助他。
